name: CodeWave
desc: low-code platform with natural-language to NASL code writing
desc_zh: 低代码平台，支持用自然语言编写 NASL 代码
solves: Business rules are locked in code only specialists can read. You describe the change in plain language and get working NASL back.
solves_zh: 业务规则锁在代码里，只有专业的人读得懂。你用日常语言描述改动，它直接返回可用的 NASL。
best_for: When domain experts need to change business logic without waiting on a developer.
best_for_zh: 业务专家想改业务逻辑、又不用等开发排期的时候。
notes: Buyers who need a governed application platform, not a code generator — it ships its own language, compiler and IDE rather than patching a general-purpose one. 来源：https://m.autohome.com.cn
